xmldoc.short_description: Read a message from the protobuf text format.

syntax.syntax_item: [value, presence, report] = protobuf.fromtext(schema, type, txt, name, value, ...)

param_input_item.param_description: a schema from protobuf.load and a message type.
a character vector: a protobuf text format document ("name: value", nested "name { }", comments with #).

description.p: protobuf.fromtext reads a message written in the Protocol Buffers text format and returns it like protobuf.decode, with the same layout options. protobuf.totext writes that format.

example_item.example_item_description: Round trip through the text format
